separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Shows that browser geolocation is an application-layer identity surface distinct from VPN exit IP. LumiNet keeps that distinction explicit rather than claiming VPN geolocation spoofing.
invariant: network egress identity and browser geolocation are separate authorities
negative_invariant: network routing must not be represented as browser geolocation authority
license_note: MIT

separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Timezone consistency is useful privacy-model evidence but is not a network transport responsibility.
invariant: timezone presentation belongs to browser/application identity
negative_invariant: VPN routing must not silently mutate application timezone semantics
license_note: MIT

separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: WebRTC can expose network-adjacent identity outside ordinary proxy paths; retained as a diagnostic/privacy caveat.
invariant: proxy coverage claims distinguish browser peer-connection behavior
negative_invariant: transport success must not imply WebRTC identity protection
license_note: MIT

value_unit: propagate identity overrides into nested frames
separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Cross-frame propagation illustrates completeness requirements for a browser extension, but LumiNet has no browser extension authority.
invariant: browser identity overrides require child-context coverage if ever implemented
negative_invariant: partial browser overrides must not be marketed as global identity
license_note: MIT

separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Worker propagation is retained as completeness evidence only.
invariant: worker execution contexts are separate identity surfaces
negative_invariant: main-frame state cannot be assumed to cover workers
license_note: MIT

value_unit: mask overridden JavaScript functions as native
separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Native-looking function masking is an anti-detection/evasion mechanism and is outside LumiNet production authority.
invariant: privacy features remain explainable and do not forge native implementation provenance
negative_invariant: target code must not hide instrumentation by falsifying native-function appearance
license_note: MIT

separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Falsifying browser permission state would duplicate browser authority and can mislead callers.
invariant: browser permission truth remains browser-owned
negative_invariant: network tools must not forge user-agent permission state
license_note: MIT

value_unit: synchronize browser location presets with observed VPN region
separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Useful UX evidence that network exit and browser identity can drift and should be shown separately.
invariant: cross-layer identity state is explicit and reconciled rather than conflated
negative_invariant: a VPN region hint is not authoritative browser geolocation
license_note: MIT

separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Early bootstrap timing is relevant only to a browser-injection product and does not justify a LumiNet extension plane.
invariant: identity hooks require defined startup ordering if ever implemented
negative_invariant: late injection must not be claimed as complete page coverage
license_note: MIT

value_unit: Safari WebExtension native bridge and packaging boundary
separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Cross-browser packaging is product reference only; LumiNet release authority remains its existing desktop/mobile packages.
invariant: platform-specific browser packaging has explicit provenance
negative_invariant: peer Safari bundles do not become LumiNet release inputs
license_note: MIT

separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Explicit socket protection reinforces the existing LumiNet VpnService.protect bridge; no second VPN service is needed.
invariant: tunnel-originated sockets use one platform-owned VPN bypass boundary
negative_invariant: peer VpnService cannot become a second Android network authority
license_note: GPL-3.0 with additional terms; bundled components separately licensed

separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Per-app routing is useful product evidence, but LumiNet correctly reports it unsupported until packet/process routing can enforce it.
invariant: availability reflects enforcement capability, not UI presence
negative_invariant: settings UI must not claim per-app enforcement without runtime authority
license_note: GPL-3.0 with additional terms; bundled components separately licensed

value_unit: VPN TUN route/DNS/MTU construction around proxy endpoint
separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Route construction and server exclusion reinforce existing Android/TUN ownership; target keeps one TUN/NAT stack.
invariant: TUN routes and bypasses are installed by one authoritative service
negative_invariant: peer route builder cannot create parallel TUN authority
license_note: GPL-3.0 with additional terms; bundled components separately licensed

value_unit: proxy DNS and FakeDNS configuration builder
separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Config UX is useful reference, but LumiNet DNS and proxy routing already have distinct owners and no V2Ray config authority is imported.
invariant: DNS policy remains explicit and target-owned
negative_invariant: peer V2Ray config cannot become target DNS source of truth
license_note: GPL-3.0 with additional terms; bundled components separately licensed

separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Parser breadth is useful compatibility evidence; current proxy configuration owners remain authoritative.
invariant: untrusted proxy inputs are parsed through bounded target-owned schemas
negative_invariant: peer parser does not gain runtime authority
license_note: GPL-3.0 with additional terms; bundled components separately licensed

separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Native tunnel lifecycle is already covered by LumiNet mobilehost/TUN ownership; importing HevTun would create a second data plane.
invariant: one target TUN owner controls fd lifecycle and teardown
negative_invariant: second native TUN engine is prohibited
license_note: GPL-3.0 with additional terms; bundled components separately licensed

separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Diagnostic sampling reinforces existing bounded endpoint diagnostics without changing dispatch authority.
invariant: diagnostics remain observational and bounded
negative_invariant: diagnostic success cannot grant routing authority
license_note: GPL-3.0 with additional terms; bundled components separately licensed

separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: A 54 MB bundled runtime archive cannot become an unaudited executable input, especially under GPL/mixed component licensing.
invariant: runtime binaries are provenance-accounted and built/admitted by target release authority
negative_invariant: peer bundled binaries cannot silently enter production
license_note: GPL-3.0 with additional terms; bundled components separately licensed

value_unit: build script clones/links external hev-socks5-tunnel source
separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Mutable external-source build recipes conflict with LumiNet frozen-source release provenance.
invariant: release inputs are pinned and auditable before build
negative_invariant: release must not clone mutable external source during packaging
license_note: GPL-3.0 with additional terms; bundled components separately licensed

value_unit: time-decaying bounded Bloom filter for recent identifiers
separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Time-decaying replay membership reinforces bounded replay windows; LumiNet already has bounded replay caches/one-shot tokens where needed.
invariant: replay state is bounded by capacity/time and never grows without limit
negative_invariant: peer replay cache does not create a second cryptographic state owner
license_note: mixed: public-domain core plus BSD/LGPL/GPL/Apache/other component licenses

value_unit: duplicate tunnel IV detection with resource-sensitive filter sizing
separability: standalone decision unit
decision_rationale: Shows replay filtering sized against memory/throughput and explicit duplicate telemetry; target uses existing replay owners.
